text: 5-day-old male newborn. The newborn's mother reports that her child has developed yellowish discoloration of the skin that started from the face and then spread to the trunk since the past day. speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Yellowish discoloration of the skin. I also have Discoloration started from the face then spread to the trunk, Scleral icterus noted. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the progression from the face to the trunk with scleral icterus is classic for jaundice. REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin_Level (confirming the trend) and REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound to rule out biliary atresia or other structural causes. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Physiological Jaundice
